claimSources.name: HCS Sovereign Governance Spine
claimSources.description: Immutable governance topic holding LICENSE_GRANT, GATEWAY_DEPLOY, SENSOR_LINK, and methodScope commissioning records. This is CO2's own governance reference (its methodScope), not a telemetry source. Verified live coordinate: topic 0.0.8479702, methodScope sequence 77, with explicit AMS-I.D external methodology declared at sequences 76-77 and governance audit event at sequence 78.

claimSources.name: Parent REC Evidence (traversal into the REC evidence layer)
claimSources.description: CO2's direct dependency is issued, minted REC evidence -- not raw telemetry. Each entry in the passport's existing parentRecEvidence array (claimId, tokenId, serial, finalHcsTopicId, finalHcsSequence -- already present in the live payload, unchanged by this extension set) is the claim source CO2 actually allocates from. Resolving a parentRecEvidence entry means fetching the REC's own passport record at finalHcsTopicId/finalHcsSequence; that REC record is, in turn, responsible for referencing the raw signed-telemetry topic that backs it (analogous to VRE-PARFE-HydroRE topic 0.0.8480236). That second-hop reference is a property of the REC passport format and is out of scope for VRE-PARFE-ContinuousCO2e.
